train_EQACNNPretrainTrainer: train the EQACNNPretrainTrainer to pre-train a MultitaskCNN encoder-decoder for EQA feature extraction
eval_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_checkpoint: evaluate an EQACNNPretrainTrainer checkpoint on the validation set and log loss metrics to TensorBoard
save_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_results: save EQA-CNN reconstruction results including RGB, segmentation, and depth map outputs to disk
create_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_results_dir: create result directories for RGB, segmentation, and depth outputs for EQA-CNN pretrain evaluation
review_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_multitask_l: review the EQACNNPretrainTrainer multitask loss computation combining segmentation, autoencoder, and depth losses
